expected: A clear chart starts with one useful observation. First, check the market you are viewing. Choose one timeframe before adding any drawings. Look for a price area you want to observe. Select H-Line in the drawing toolbar. Click once on the chart to mark that level. Pause and check where your line landed. Return to Cursor when you finish drawing. A marked level does not guarantee a price reaction. Practise marking one level, then explain why you chose it.

expected: Understand Oracle's percentage before using it. Open Oracle for the chart you are reviewing. In this example, eight of the nine checks pass. Eight divided by nine rounds to eighty-nine percent. This is confluence: a count of conditions that agree. It is not the probability that a trade will win. Oracle and Aria use the same checks, so they are not independent confirmations. In another example, only six of nine checks agree. Read the reasons. Aria says waiting, so leave Apply unused. Tools help you prepare. Review the evidence, and decide with care.
